entities.name: Mtenda Plains
entities.description: Vast plains on Zhalfir, its breadbasket and home to many griffins.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Plane of which the Mtenda are part.

entities.name: Ntatsu Plains
entities.description: Southern portion of the Mtenda, ancestral lands of Rashida Scalebane.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: Youth of the Mtenda whose failed rite of passage led to bloodshed.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: Offered Vuel a place as the Evincar of Rath.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out the region to spare it from the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

events.summary: After Vuel's failed rite of passage, Starke il-Vec offers him the role of Evincar of Rath and vengeance, causing bloodshed.
events.quote: Starke il-Vec offered the youth a place as the Evincar of Rath

events.summary: Teferi phases out northwestern Jamuraa including the Mtenda to spare it from the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: since the planeswalker Teferi wanted to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: The Mtenda are lost from Dominaria when Jeska destroys the time rift.
events.quote: They were forever lost from Dominaria when Jeska destroyed the time rift

events.summary: The phased-out plains return to the multiverse as part of Zhalfir after the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: They now exist as part of the plane of Zhalfir.
